inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted = H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS denominator (479,363k weighted basic + 18,336k options/RSUs = 497,699k; interim report note 12). Issued shares 489,307k at 30 Jun 2026 less 2,058k repurchased-pending-cancellation (cancelled 11 Aug 2026) and ~6,143k held by the RSU trustee give ~481.1m basic outstanding at period end. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so charging dilution too would double-count. Buybacks (RMB512m in H1 FY2026) are the cash mechanism funding the flat count.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and cash equivalents RMB3,778.775m + short-term investments RMB118.672m at 30 Jun 2026 (interim report, statement of financial position). No borrowings or convertible bonds at 30 Jun 2026 (interim p.719: 'we did not have any borrowings'). Lease liabilities RMB112.8m are deducted in equity_bridge (treatment A), not in total_debt, to keep total_debt on the same bonds-plus-borrowings basis as the Metrics CSV.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation and cash-flow statement, 'Share-based compensation expenses' RMB92,483k (lines 610/7350). Equity-award cash taxes: none disclosed (HKEX filer, no net-share-settlement withholding line), so the combined figure equals the add-back.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 1,390.6 (OCF 1,712.6 - capex 322.0) - SBC 92.5 - interest income 46.7 = RMB1,251.4m. FY2025 capex includes RMB311.9m of intangible purchases, dominated by the ~US$37.2m Torchlight IP acquisition; on a run-rate capex of ~RMB35m owner FCF would be ~RMB1,530m. TTM to 30 Jun 2026 owner FCF (incl. the IP one-off) = 1,251.4 + 621.5 - 545.6 = RMB1,327m. The forward build uses run-rate capex, not the FY2025 figure.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 cash repurchases RMB105.1m; H1 FY2026 RMB512.0m (7,882,600 shares, all cancelled by 11 Aug 2026). Management has replaced the cash dividend with buyback-and-cancel; the flat share count is being funded.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:01Z. Statements and all flows are RMB (filings print RMB'000; this file is RMB millions); the HKEX quote is HKD. No dual listing exists for a parity check; the CNY/HKD rate has moved within 1.07-1.18 over the last decade, so FX is a second-order risk to the HKD value. Per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate for the HKD (quote-currency) headline.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.2 x China/HK-listed internet ERP ~7% (incl. country and VIE-structure premium) = cost of equity ~10.2%; zero debt so WACC = cost of equity, rounded to 10.0%. Held identical across scenarios: hit-title, regulatory and tax-regime risk is charged once, in the scenario flows and weights, not again in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt. IFRS 16 lease liabilities RMB112.8m (30 Jun 2026) deducted once via equity_bridge; lease principal (~RMB45m/yr) is NOT deducted from the flows, D&A keeps right-of-use depreciation, and ongoing lease-asset renewal (~0.8% of revenue) is charged inside capex_pct. No lease_cost_pct_path, so the lease is charged exactly once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: non-controlling interests (balance RMB244.7m at 30 Jun 2026; profit share FY2024 8.9%, FY2025 7.3%, H1 FY2026 1.4%) are folded into cash_tax_rate_path as ~3pp of combined tax-plus-NCI leakage. NCI is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY2025 attributable NI ex interest income ~RMB1,490m against owner EBIT (adj. EBITDA 1,787.9 - SBC 92.5 - D&A 77.8 = 1,617.6m) implies ~8% combined leakage in FY2025; year-1 is set at 13% because H1 FY2026 shows the preferential-tax regime tightening (see tax note).
inputs.tax_note: Statutory PRC CIT 25%; main subsidiaries hold HNTE status at 15%; 200% R&D super deduction; FY2025 effective rate only 3.6% (RMB62.4m on PBT 1,718.9m) helped by preferential rates (-243m), super deduction (-66m) and utilisation of unrecognised losses (-41m). H1 FY2026 booked RMB96.7m of supplementary CIT and surcharges after a self-assessment 'in response to developments in regulatory interpretations regarding certain preferential tax benefits enjoyed historically'; underlying H1 rate ex one-off ~5%, cash taxes paid RMB131m. The forward cash-tax path therefore ramps well above the historical rate: base 10% -> 18% underlying tax (+3pp NCI) by year 5, reflecting partial loss of preferential treatment and eventual 5-10% WHT on repatriating PRC earnings (RMB2,320m undistributed, no WHT provided) to fund HoldCo buybacks.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company; routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md operating-company row, with owner-fcf-adaptations for currency, leases and NCI). First valuation of this ticker; no prior DCF or memory entry. 10-year explicit horizon because the cash-tax rate is still ramping through year 5. Interest income stripped (net cash RMB3.9bn is ~3x the owner-FCF base) and cash added back in the bridge; long-term investments (equity-method RMB117.9m + FVTPL RMB113.1m) added at book because their income (share of results, FV gains) is excluded from adjusted EBITDA and from the flows. Working-capital capture 0%: deferred revenue is only ~RMB250-290m and flat, receivables and developer payables roughly offset. Adjusted EBITDA (company definition: operating profit + D&A + SBC, excl. FV gains) is the EBITDA line; FY2025 31.0%, H1 FY2026 27.8% after AI-related R&D step-up.

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 statement of financial position; their income is excluded from the flows (matching-asset rule)
Lease treatment (A): leases as debt, deducted once here; principal not deducted from flows

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: year-1 base growth anchored on H1 FY2026 revenue +7.5% YoY and the equity 5yr CAGR (10.7%); the revenue 5yr CAGR (15.1%) is flattered by the FY2024 Heartopia launch (+48%) and the 3yr figures start from the loss-making FY2022 trough
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 220.7 -> FY2025 1,251.4 (41.5%/yr) is a recovery from a near-zero base, not a trend. 3yr EPS and owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined because FY2022 was a loss year (EPS -1.17, owner FCF -521m); 5yr EPS CAGR is undefined in practice (FY2020 EPS 0.02). Equity 5yr CAGR 10.7% vs revenue 15.1% is a 29% relative gap, just under the 30% warning threshold; the gap is buybacks and the FY2021-22 losses, not a quality issue. SBC/revenue has been stable at 1.5-1.8% so the owner-FCF and reported-FCF growth paths do not diverge materially.

base.narrative: FY2026 revenue +8% (H1 +7.5%, Heartopia global launch and RO: Eternal Love 2 relaunch support H2), re-accelerating to ~10% in FY2027 as TapTap platform revenue (+25% FY2025) keeps compounding and new titles land, then fading to 3% by year 10 as TapTap PRC MAU (~45m) saturates. Adjusted EBITDA margin recovers only partially from the H1 FY2026 AI-spend dip (27.8%) to 29%, below the 31% FY2025 peak that carried a favourable net-basis mix. Combined cash tax + NCI leakage ramps from 13% to 21% as preferential tax treatment is partially lost and repatriation WHT bites. Capex 1.5% of revenue covers PPE (~0.2%), routine IP/intangibles (~0.5%) and lease-asset renewal (~0.8%); occasional IP purchases like Torchlight are absorbed within that over the cycle.

bull.narrative: Heartopia's global launch becomes a second evergreen alongside Torchlight: Infinite (now royalty-free after the IP purchase), RO: Eternal Love 2 holds Southeast Asia, and TapTap Maker's AI-built games expand exclusive content and ad inventory on TapTap PRC. Growth re-accelerates to 15% in FY2027 and the platform mix lifts EBITDA margin to 33%; HNTE status is retained so the tax ramp stops at 19% combined. TapTap International remains unmonetised even here.

bear.narrative: The top-five titles fade faster than new launches replace them (online-game MAU/MPU already fell ~20% in FY2025), Heartopia's global launch underwhelms, and AI-era content oversupply plus Tencent/NetEase/miHoYo traffic competition cap TapTap ad yield while AI compute keeps R&D elevated: revenue stalls in FY2027-28 and EBITDA margin settles at 22%. The H1 FY2026 supplementary tax payment proves to be the start of losing preferential treatment, so combined tax + NCI leakage rises to 25%. No solvency issue: RMB3.9bn net cash and no debt keep this a margin-and-growth bear, not a going-concern one.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-single to low-double-digit growth for five years driven by TapTap platform advertising (+25% in FY2025, 34% of revenue, structurally higher margin) and a more diversified game portfolio (Heartopia, Torchlight: Infinite, RO franchise), fading to 3% as TapTap PRC saturates near 45m MAU. Margins recover partially from the AI-spend dip; the cash-tax rate normalises upward from an unsustainable 4-5%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Heartopia global and RO: Eternal Love 2 become durable overseas franchises, Torchlight IP ownership removes royalty drag, TapTap Maker feeds a wave of exclusive AI-built content into the zero-revenue-share platform, and operating leverage lifts EBITDA margin to 33% with HNTE tax status retained.
scenario_narratives.bear: Hit-title decay outruns the pipeline, TapTap ad yield is capped by traffic competition and AI content oversupply, AI compute keeps R&D elevated, and the preferential-tax regime is largely withdrawn. Revenue stalls for two years and settles at 3% growth on a 22% margin. Balance-sheet strength means the floor is a cash-rich, slow-growing platform, not distress.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: revenue is hit-driven with the top five games carrying most game revenue, PRC content approval and minors rules are a single-regulator dependency, and the H1 FY2026 supplementary tax payment shows the preferential-tax regime that produced a ~4% effective rate is now in question. Bull cut to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once (Heartopia global, RO overseas, TapTap Maker monetisation, margin recovery, tax status retained). Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: XD is valued as a cash-generative, debt-free Chinese game publisher whose durable asset is TapTap, a zero-revenue-share discovery platform monetised through advertising. The house basis fully expenses SBC (small here, ~1.7% of revenue), strips interest income on the RMB3.9bn cash pile and adds the cash back once in the bridge, charges leases once as debt, charges minorities once in the flows, and ramps the cash-tax rate to a normal level rather than perpetuating the FY2025 3.6% effective rate. Hit-title, regulatory and tax-regime risk is priced in the scenario flows and a 25% bear weight, not by stacking a premium on the 10% CNY WACC. The FY2025 Torchlight IP purchase is treated as a one-off outside run-rate capex.
key_risks_to_valuation: Hit-title concentration: top-five games carry most game revenue; online-game MAU/MPU fell ~20% in FY2025 as Heartopia and Sausage Man normalised

Tax regime: the FY2025 3.6% effective rate rests on HNTE 15% status, R&D super deduction and loss utilisation; H1 FY2026's RMB96.7m supplementary CIT after a regulatory self-assessment is a warning, and RMB2,320m of PRC earnings carry no WHT provision
PRC regulation: NPPA licence timing, minors' protection rules, advertising/algorithm rules and the VIE structure
Margin trajectory: H1 FY2026 revenue +7.5% but profit -10.6% as AI-related R&D and distribution commissions rose faster than revenue
Platform ceiling: TapTap PRC MAU ~45m is near domestic saturation and TapTap International MAU fell 38% YoY and is unmonetised
Currency: value computed in CNY and quoted in HKD at 1.1724; the rate is dated 2026-10-16 and is not refreshed by price updates
